decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - That this consent for a limited period of five years expiring on 12/4/2009.

Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 6 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 7 - The permanent signs are to be of a corporate nature related to the occupiers of the building,
Condition : 8 - The signs shall not incorporate anf form of flash and tntermittent light.

Condition : 9 - The signs shall not display any alternative advertisement design faces which change periodically (except in so far as necessary from time to time to change the whole advertisement face in the course of maintenance or installation of a different advertisement).
Condition : 10 - The degree of maximum illumination provided to the signs is not to exceed the levels recommended in Technical Report No. 5 (Second Edition) of the Institute of Lighting Engineers.

LONDON BOROUGH OF HOUNSLOW

TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING ACT1990

Appeal by Mr D. Malhi under Section 78 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 against the decision of the London Borough of Hounslow to refuse planning permission for the erection of a two storey side, single storey and two storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse at 680 Great West Road, Osterley.

DoE Ref:
LPA Ref: 00505/680/P5

STATEMENT OF LOCAL PLANING AUTHORITY

1.0	APPEAL SITE AND SURROUNDINGS

1.1	Detached house, 1950's style in need of repair with a large rear garden facing onto the Great West Road.  The house has an unfinished porch at the front with quantities of building materials lying about in the front garden.  A large extension on the east side of the house at the rear was recently built as a permitted development extension at 5m in depth.  Foundations have been laid at the rear of the garden for a large building with a brick and concrete base, 5.5m wide by 11m wide (measured on site).  There is parking in the front garden.  The area is primarily residential.  (See Ordnance Survey extract at Appendix 1).

2.0	HISTORY

2.1	P1 Erection of 2 dwellinghouses - granted 1955.
	P2 Erection of a dwellinghouse - granted 1955.
	P3 Erection of a two storey extension to dwellinghouse - granted 1955.
	P4 Erection of a 2-storey side, single storey and two storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse - withdrawn 2003.
	P5 Erection of a two storey side, single and double storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse refused permission in 2003 and is the subject of this Appeal.

3.0	THE APPLICATION THE SUBJECT OF THIS APPEAL

3.1	The application which is the subject of this appeal was received by the Local Planning Authority on 10 November 2003.

3.2	The applicants propose to erect a 2 storey side, single storey and two storey rear extension to the existing dwellinghouse.
